metadata.description: A single-plugin marketplace for the GRO Compiler — a live, per-turn GRO material compiler for Claude Code.

plugins.name: gro-compiler
plugins.description: Per-turn (live) GRO material compiler: keeps a project's ARA extended with the GRO material layer (temporal, refs, quantities, entities, claims_typed, genre, author-stated contributions) compiled at the end of every agent turn. Pure material compilation — no metrics, no judgments. The GRO analog of the ARA research-manager.
